body:
Fixes for the failures seen in the work runs on a task in another project (4c636ac1a94fc001 there). There, agents spent many steps working around Solace, and one run lost work without anyone noticing.

- **Imports:** dependency modules and aliases already used in the project aren't added automatically, and an import-only patch is refused.
- **Open drafts:** `task done` goes through while a draft still holds unsaved work.
- **Refusal messages:** wrong-project paths, `read` on Gleam source, `view` without `--project` and `inspect module:…` give messages that don't name the call that works.

Not here: letting read-only runs use `run env`. That needs no code: mark it `allowed_in_reviews = true` in that project's `solace.toml`.
title: Work run friction fixes
